- `target` parameter (channel/user ID or name)

Without this, automated messages to orchestrate TNF tasks were silently dropped.

### Root Cause Analysis
The handoff matrix tracks tasks but lacks active assignment mechanism. Critical TNF validation task was repeatedly identified without state transitions, leading to implementation gaps.

- Added acceptance workflow to prevent silent drops
- Documented integration points for handoff matrix extension
